'''Nyriaanan''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] that was spoken by the [[Nyriaanan]]s, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. It was essentially a mixture of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]].<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
